messages:
elena: P95 for text-generation in us-west spiked ~2.4x over the last 30m. Getting a couple of customer escalations. Anyone oncall to kick off triage?
ashwin: I'm oncall, grabbing logs now. Any ongoing deploys?
deploy-bot: Deploy started by @mia: runtime v2.14.3 -> rolling on us-west (instances: gpu-12-3,gpu-12-4,gpu-12-5). status: 42% complete.
mia: yep, small runtime change to KV eviction heuristics + kernel selection. rolling back if we see clear regressions.
ashwin: please hold the roll forward. if rollback isn't fast, we should route traffic to fallback models/regions.
tomas: seeing customer reports with long tails and some 500s. sample stack/latency from one request: 
```
WARN runtime/kv_cache.go: miss_rate=0.42 p95_latency_ms=320 host=gpu-12-3
INFO server/request.go: path=/v1/generate dur_ms=504 status=200 model=redwood-large-v1 tokens=128
ERROR runtime/exec.go: kernel-alloc-timeout host=gpu-12-4 queue_len=7
```
ashwin: interesting — miss_rate jumped from ~0.06 to 0.42 after the rollout window. KV cache evictions or changed cache key shape could explain expensive recompute on hot prefixes.
mia: rolling back v2.14.3 on gpu-12-3/4/5 now (step 1). also dropping max_batch_size 32->16 and disabling continuous-batching on the group as fast mitigation.
ashwin: enabling circuit breaker to protect tail:
```
{\n  "circuit_breaker": {\n    "enabled": true,\n    "reject_threshold": 0.75,\n    "consecutive_reject_window_sec": 30,\n    "initial_backoff_ms": 50\n  }\n}
```
ashwin: and temporarily add fallback routing policy for us-west to spill 20% traffic to us-east and 15% to redwood-medium-v1 (to reduce per-token work).
mia: applying fallback policy now — will monitor p95/p99.
karen: we should also update customer-facing messaging and open an incident with severity=high. Notifying affected customers and offering credits if SLA impacted.
sre-bot: SLO check: baseline p95=120ms, p99=450ms. Current us-west p95=290ms, p99=1.2s -> breach window triggered.
ashwin: playbook (short):
1) Abort/rollback any in-flight runtime deploys in region.
2) Reduce max_batch_size and disable continuous-batching for affected pool.
3) Enable circuit breaker (reject_threshold=0.75) and set client-side Retry-After headers.
4) Apply model fallback: route X% to redwood-medium-v1 / redwood-mini-v1 and consider cross-region spill to us-east.
5) If tail persists >10m, drain traffic from problematic nodes and repro on staging with same load shape.
6) Postmortem + add automated guardrail: if p95 > 1.5x baseline for 5m, auto-enable fallback and notify oncall.

ashwin: I've created a short-run runbook entry and toggled circuit-breaker + fallback. Monitoring graphs now.
mia: rollback finished on 3 instances. early signal: p95 dipped from 290ms -> 140ms in 90s. continuing observation.
tomas: notified top 3 affected customers via support. keeping them updated.
elena: great, thanks. can we add a small regression test for KV cache shape in preflight? add to rollout gating.
mia: yea i'll add a quick synthetic that exercises long prefix reuse and checks miss_rate < 0.1 before canary.
karen: product request: make the guardrail config editable per-customer so enterprise customers can opt to be excluded from automatic fallbacks.
ashwin: noted. action items: rollback confirmed, circuit-breaker + fallback enabled, update playbook + add preflight KV test. owners: @mia (rollback + preflight), @ashwin (guardrails + playbook), @tomas (customer comms).
ashwin: will keep thread updated with metrics. :eyes:
